nodes.label: Decision: Permit Vhot-Only Edits to Carry Live-Good One-Face Stubs
nodes.rationale: LGMD Modify Existing may carry a live-proven one-face hand stub forward for vhot-only metadata edits so AR15 vhot authoring doesn't require rebuilding the ladder candidate or enabling the risky one-face-stub test checkbox. Superseded same-day by visible-name override fix.

nodes.label: Decision: Visible Vhot Helper Names Override Stale Cloned IDs
nodes.rationale: When a 3ds Max helper's visible vhot_## name disagrees with its hidden ss2vr_lgmd_vhot_id property (from cloning), the visible name wins, since artists expect renamed helpers to be authoritative. Fixed a duplicate-vhot-id-0 export failure. Superseded by v0.6.23-vhotcarry.

nodes.label: Decision: Carry Accepted One-Face Source Stubs for Metadata-Only Edits
nodes.rationale: For live-proven vhot-free fingerprints (pistol/AR15/laser), preserve the source one-face hand stub during metadata edits even if the matching Max mesh/helper is missing, so losing a tiny visible stub doesn't force a risky new ladder export.

nodes.label: Decision: Skip Sub-Epsilon Vertex Writes in Metadata-Only Exports
nodes.rationale: LGMD Modify Existing writes vertex positions only when the Max/source delta exceeds 1e-5, because sub-epsilon float round-trip noise changed the vhot-free fingerprint and made the strict validator treat metadata-only exports as unproven geometry variants.

nodes.label: Decision: Accept Repaired One-Face Hand-Stub Overrides by Exact Digest
nodes.rationale: Accept the repaired one-face hand-stub pattern only for exact live-proven digests (atek_h.bin, ar15_h.bin, lasehand.bin); full pruning crashed and zero-face husks crashed/hung, so digest-specific allowlisting is the safe middle ground. Rejected: generic one-face-stub acceptance without live proof.

nodes.label: Decision (Falsified): Full Hand-Subobject Pruning for Pistol/AR/Laser
nodes.rationale: Tried removing deleted hand subobjects entirely and remapping BSP nodes as the next-smallest test after one-face stubs proved unsafe. Live testing falsified this: pistol/AR/laser still crashed, with AR's crash dump containing LGMD/ar15gun in the game-side loader. Superseded by v1.87 stock-rig rollback.

nodes.label: Decision: Repair LGMD v4 Material Tails Instead of Zeroing Them
nodes.rationale: Zeroing (mat_flags, off_mat_extra, size_mat_extra) avoided stale donor pointers but the SG/EMP crash comparison showed the zeroed header itself was an equip-loader hazard. Exporters must repoint the v4 material-extra header to the current aux table and update the v4 end offset after compaction; validator rejects stale/zeroed extras for aux-bearing LGMDs.

nodes.label: Decision: Treat Stale LGMD Light/Normal Ranges as Unsafe
nodes.rationale: EMP and shotgun still crashed/hung after hand-husk files were removed because face deletion left stale subobject light_offset/light_count and normal_offset/normal_count ranges. LGMD Modify Existing must compact light/normal chunks together with face/node chunks; validator must reject stale aux ranges.

nodes.label: Decision: Treat One-Face Animated Hand Husks as Unsafe
nodes.rationale: The validator only rejected zero-face subobjects, so one-face stubbed exports (v0.6.12-safestubs) passed but still crashed/hung VR weapon switching. Extended the runtime-safety rule to also block one-retained-face hand children until live-proven otherwise.

nodes.label: Decision: Park Runtime Weapon Swaps and Zero-Face Weapon Overrides
nodes.rationale: A game-side LGMD loader crash (INT3) traced to a same-name pistol override retaining zero-face animated hand subobjects, even though material extras were zeroed. Legacy ss2vr_weapon_model_swap must not enable runtime ModelName changes; runtime swaps require explicit unsafe opt-in plus strict validator pass.

nodes.label: Decision: Funk Mesh Missing Non-Root Nodes = Face Deletion, Not Subobject Removal
nodes.rationale: A missing imported non-root subobject mesh node in Max means 'delete all original faces from this preserved subobject,' keeping LGMD subobject/joint/node identity intact so AE weapon animation/PointRig can still reference it even with an empty face list. Funk Direct stays strict and move-only.

nodes.label: Decision: Keep LGMM Import Separate from LGMD Export
nodes.rationale: LGMM is a segmented/skinned mesh format paired with .CAL, while FunkMaxExport writers emit static LGMD; added read-only LGMM parsing/import tagged separately and excluded from LGMD export to avoid producing misleading assets. CAL/bind-pose/weights export not claimed until understood.

nodes.label: Decision: Restore Flatlit Left-Hand Baseline; RenderDoc Gates Further Material Work
nodes.rationale: ss2vr_ls (flatlit, shaded 0) is the only known-visible standalone custom hand fallback after ss2vr_lk/lm proved invisible and ss2vr_ln crashed; no new material variants before a RenderDoc A/B of the shaded-1 white state versus stock hand identifies the missing pass input.

nodes.label: Decision: FlatAim Reticle Offset Moves to Native Overlay-Table Proof
nodes.rationale: Stop tuning Squirrel reticle offsets after the WorldToScreen aim-ray path was falsified as facing-dependent; use a read-only DLL probe of native overlay slot 22 (gOverlayOrder/gOverlayRects) to find the native rect/anchor first.

nodes.label: Decision: Treat Additive-Hand Render Proof and Visible Pixels as Separate Gates
nodes.rationale: Squirrel logging renderedThisFrame=1 is not proof of visible geometry; ss2vr_lk was selected/posed/reported rendered but the user still saw no mesh, so further probes must split GPU/visual contribution from BIN material-table shape and material pass behavior.

nodes.label: Decision: Aim/Facing Conventions Single-Sourced; SS2VR Brought to Parity with FlatAim
nodes.rationale: Shared Dark-engine aim/facing math is canonicalized in docs/CONVENTIONS.md; SS2VR and FlatAim stay separate products sharing conventions, not code. A graphify drift audit found SS2VR lacked engine-side heading/basis helpers FlatAim already had, causing inline math that produced the FlatAim laser-diagonal bug class.

nodes.label: Decision: Package or Inline Material Include Chains in Custom KPF Materials
nodes.rationale: ss2vr_lj crashed while using include ../../materials/ND-hand.inc because a custom mod KPF cannot assume base sshock2ee material .inc files are reachable by relative path; custom materials must inline passes or package every include dependency locally.

nodes.label: Principle: Keep Stabilized Sidequest Configs User-Facing
nodes.rationale: Once a path is confirmed live, public sample INIs should expose only user-facing tuning knobs; failed experiments/probes stay available as hidden diagnostics, default off, so stacked stale workarounds don't accumulate in the shipped config surface.

nodes.label: Decision: Import the FreeAim View-Frame Lesson into SS2VR Pose/Aim Systems
nodes.rationale: FlatAim proved adding screen/controller offsets to world heading/pitch fails near pitch extremes (pole/roll weirdness). SS2VR had the same problem family in visible weapon bank, two-hand pitch, spread preservation, and held-object rotation; fix is to treat controller pose as a full frame (origin/forward/right/up) and express offsets as view-frame tangent offsets rather than world heading/pitch deltas. Rejected: continued sign-flip/HMD-roll-compensation layering.

nodes.label: Decision: Snap-Turn Gain Is Linear Again
nodes.rationale: A dedicated F3 snap capture proved direction/pitch were stable and the only error was a 1.4x gain; set snap_turn_pixels_per_degree back to 1.0. Rejected: flipping signs again or reintroducing object-direct yaw.

nodes.label: Decision: CameraObj Remains Animation Surface, Not Proven World-Locked Visual Surface
nodes.rationale: HMD-bleed logs showed stable world/controller fields while visible CameraObj local fields moved with HMD/KEX camera, so the pose bridge is fine but the AE viewmodel consumption layer is the remaining problem. Stop treating CameraObj sign/Euler patches as the primary fix; explore a default-off world/proxy visual weapon/hand path instead.

nodes.label: Decision: FlatAim Bakes Projectile Baseline and Attaches Weapon Effects Through PointRig
nodes.rationale: Bakes proj_viewframe=1 defaults; muzzle flash and shell ejection reuse native viewmodel PointRig helpers rebased onto the freeaim world proxy pose, kept separate from projectile redirect since AE scripts spawn muzzle flash and shell eject as distinct object/effect paths from the projectile itself.

nodes.label: Decision: Treat Squirrel Camera.GetFacing as Bank/Pitch/Heading
nodes.rationale: FlatAim diagnostics proved Camera.GetFacing() is (x=bank, y=pitch, z=heading), not heading-first; code that read .x as heading silently aimed relative to world-north. Use a named helper instead of raw .x/.y/.z access. Does not apply to projectile velocity vectors or controller rays, which are already world-vector form.

nodes.label: Decision: Gravity-Glove Catch Becomes a Hand-Follow Hold
nodes.rationale: After a successful pull/catch, hand the object into the existing grab/hold lane with a short hand-distance target instead of leaving it floating at a ray/beam point, reusing the proven hold/release path to minimize mission-risk writes.

nodes.label: Decision: Physical Quick-Item Proxy Uses Native Inventory Command First
nodes.rationale: First hypospray/medpatch VR use is a transient right-hand proxy model dispatching use_obj med patch after contact/dwell; real inventory stays source of truth and the proxy is presentation-only, preserving existing gameplay rules before inventing object spawning or extraction.

nodes.label: Decision: VR Body Should Start From Avatar/LGMM Evidence, Not Static LGMD
nodes.rationale: AE player bodies are LGMM skeletal meshes (player.bin parses as LGMM, not LGMD) and old Shock source shows avatar archetype/puppet systems; static LGMD works for hands/items/weapons but is not enough for a posed full body. Rejected: duplicating the static hand/viewmodel pipeline or a static torso/legs LGMD.

nodes.label: Decision: OpenXR Marker Layers Use Fresh Predicted Pose, Not Pair-Locked Submitted Pose
nodes.rationale: Selection bracket and healthbar layers are independent OpenXR composition layers, not captured scene pixels, and should not inherit pair-lock's submitted/older pose; build them from freshest predicted head pose, falling back to rendered-scene then submitted stereo-pair pose only if nothing fresher exists.

nodes.label: Decision: VR Selection Marker Must Be Mono/Pre-Eye, Not Per-Eye
nodes.rationale: Computing the bracket from the post-stereo per-eye view baked left/right IPD offsets into one shared marker, presenting as a doubled/trailing bracket; compute from the pre-eye-offset mono view instead, matching the rule already applied to aim_residual_flat. Rejected: publishing a full world-space marker contract immediately (too much risk surface) or tuning bracket smoothing/depth (hides symptom).

nodes.label: Decision: Manual Reload Tier 1 Requests Native Unload/Reload
nodes.rationale: First manual reload is a pose/state detector dispatching native unload_gun/reload_gun commands rather than modifying ammo counts or weapon state directly, since KEX already owns reload legality; per-weapon visual choreography deferred until the gameplay trigger is proven.

nodes.label: Decision: Two-Handed Weapons Use Right-Primary, Left-Constraint Ownership
nodes.rationale: Right hand remains sole weapon owner (origin/position/roll/fire); left hand is a secondary support constraint only near the support point, matching common VR practice and avoiding two controllers writing conflicting CameraObj state. Rejected: independent dual-hand writes, or requiring per-weapon mesh support points before any testable behavior.

nodes.label: Decision: Gravity Glove Stays Pickup-Only Until Forced Physics Is Proven
nodes.rationale: First gravity-glove pass reuses the existing filtered physics grab lane and requires live Physics.HasPhysics/PhysState rather than forcibly registering physics on arbitrary mission objects, since forced registration can break scripts, inventory ownership, containers, doors, and mission state.

nodes.label: Decision: Enemy Healthbar Rides Selected-Object HP, Not Native HUD Slicing
nodes.rationale: Reads HitPoints/MAX_HP from the same stabilized Squirrel-selected object that publishes ss2vr_hl, drawing the bar as a separate OpenXR quad above the bracket, because scraping the native flat HUD healthbar would inherit flat-screen alignment/depth problems.

nodes.label: Decision: Controller Tracking Owns Gameplay Frob While Native Centre Selection Becomes Fallback
nodes.rationale: Hide the native centre crosshair and clear native centre object/hover/frob globals while either hand controller is tracking, restoring native fallback only when both controllers go stale, because multiple selection systems (VR bracket, native flat HUD bracketing, centre-screen picking) were visibly active simultaneously. Rejected: visually covering the crosshair (leaves native picking active underneath).

nodes.label: Decision: Native Movement Proves Held KEX Actions Before Analog Axes
nodes.rationale: Publishes OpenXR stick values as ss2vr_move then sends held in-game movement actions via Debug.Command, suppressing WASD fallback, because the Squirrel reverse bridge is a safer first proof than a guessed native axis-dispatcher RVA hook; true analog speed not claimed until the KEX axis dispatcher is confirmed.

nodes.label: Decision: CameraObj Visual Pose Uses Native KEX Camera Frame in Authoritative Mode
nodes.rationale: Projectile/right-hand aim world fields stay raw and controller-authored, but in render_view_authoritative=true, visible weapon/hand CameraObj fields are produced by projecting the stable controller world pose back into the native pre-override KEX camera frame, since CameraObj is authored before the HMD-authoritative RenderView rewrite and raw HMD-local is the wrong frame when they diverge.

nodes.label: Decision: Add Row-Level Weighted Percent Complete to the Phase Tracker
nodes.rationale: Keep YES/BUILT/EXPLORING/NO as the human-readable status source of truth, and add a derived weighted Percent Complete column (100/75/35/0) per row so the tracker stays scannable while showing per-phase completion.

nodes.label: Decision (Resolved): Left-Hand World Frob = Squirrel World-Space Scan + Engine-Frob
nodes.rationale: Card slots/switches have no collision so ray/cursor picks can't hit them, and the screen-cursor is head/camera-coupled; ships as (1) Squirrel world-space proximity scan for selection, (2) ss2vr_hl publish-back so the DLL draws the bracket, (3) writing the target into engine frob globals so native USE supplies Frobber=player for inventory checks. Rejected: ray_trace/pick_camera_probe/flat-cursor calibration, and hand-sent FrobWorldEnd (crashes or lacks Frobber).

nodes.label: Decision: Use Observed-KEX-Yaw Display-Baseline Steps for HMD-Authoritative Smooth Turn
nodes.rationale: In render_view_authoritative=true, held smooth turn must update the cached display baseline from observed KEX yaw delta (not requested joystick degrees) and keep the sample alive across short gaps, because full baseline recapture baked off-axis HMD pitch into the baseline (horizon snap) and request-based yaw had the wrong gain. Rejected: repeated full rebaseline, request-based yaw-only, and opposite-sign observed-KEX correction (all live-falsified).

nodes.label: Decision: Keep Skill Spread but Suppress View Recoil for VR Weapons
nodes.rationale: Spread: re-apply the engine's skill-based spread cone around the controller ray at projectile redirect instead of setting the raw controller ray, preserving skill balance. Recoil: never apply GunKick's view-angle kick to the HMD view (nausea hazard); express recoil via controller haptics and a transient viewmodel CameraObj kick instead. Rejected: pinpoint shots (drops skill balance) or letting native GunKick kick the view.

nodes.label: Decision: Test Main-Menu VR Control Through DLL Navigation Bridge First
nodes.rationale: Start Phase 2.4 with a default-off DLL/controller navigation bridge instead of Squirrel or Options-RML cvar experiments, since AE main/options menus are native RmlUi running before the Squirrel layer and the Options data model is fixed, so custom ss2vr_* controls cannot bind directly. Ray-and-cursor menu interaction is deferred as polish.

nodes.label: Principle: Melee Synthetic Fire Must Fail Closed
nodes.rationale: Release synthetic native fire immediately when the weapon-hand pose becomes invalid/inactive during a melee gesture, since a tracking drop during a charged swing could otherwise leave native fire held down until tracking returned or a timeout fired; real trigger input and synthetic gesture input must not fight over native fire release timing.

nodes.label: Decision: Keep Deliverable Requirements Visible in the Tracker
nodes.rationale: Use dedicated Google Sheet columns (HMD ONLY, MOTION CONTROLS, ROOMSCALE) to mark which tasks are required per deliverable tier, since the project now has multiple viable deliverable shapes and the tracker needs to show blocking work without overloading the simple phase/status columns.

nodes.label: Decision: Prototype Weapon Handoff Through AE Squirrel Viewmodel
nodes.rationale: Validate the AE mod-layer path before adding more native weapon writes: a top-priority KPF probe overrides only sq_scripts/libs/viewmodel.nut and changes gun CameraObj placement, since the first-person gun is positioned every frame by Squirrel CameraObj writes. Rejected: chasing generic native movement/LOS traces, or writing native WeaponOffset/PlyrArm/creature-attachment transforms before the script path is tested.

nodes.label: Decision: Switch Weapon Probe From Class Replacement to Unique Squirrel Handler
nodes.rationale: The v0.2 viewmodel.nut replacement never printed and had no effect, so ship a unique sq_scripts/ss2vr_weapon_probe.nut registering a late ND.g_PlayerCore handler that writes CameraObj after Nightdive's normal WeaponHandler update, isolating loader behavior from class-replacement semantics. v0.5 absolute writes confirmed CameraObj as the correct Phase 4.2 control surface.

nodes.label: Decision: Weapon Aim Returns to Log-Only Carrier Identification
nodes.rationale: 0x3FCAA5 and 0x3FE22B are downstream moving-object physics/LOS, not direct weapon-aim sinks; add default-off log-only carrier probes and suppress older experimental trace/launch rewrites while they run, since pistol/laser tests didn't hit the earlier handler traces. Rejected: patching 0x3FCAA5 globally, or trusting the old handler traces without fresh evidence.

nodes.label: Decision: Right-Hand Hitscan Takeover Rewrites Handler Trace End Only
nodes.rationale: Use the guarded FUN_1404574c0 segment-trace hook only for confirmed return RVAs 0x3EF0E7/0x3EF14E inside FUN_1403eedd0, rewriting only end.xyz while preserving KEX's original start point, range, and cell metadata, gated on right_hand_aim plus a valid weapon-hand ray, to avoid shooting around corners. Rejected: tuning FUN_14051ee80, globally rewriting all trace calls, or moving shot origin to the controller in the first prototype.

nodes.label: Decision: Predict Locked Stereo Pairs to Their Submit Frame
nodes.rationale: Added pair_lock_prediction_frames (default 2.0) since a locked stereo pair takes two game frames to assemble and the prior lastPredictedDisplayTime+1-period target underpredicted the first eye of a two-frame locked pair. Rejected: disabling pair lock by default, or hardcoding a larger prediction without an INI knob.

nodes.label: Decision: Retry Authoritative RenderView as a Diagnostic, Not Baseline
nodes.rationale: render_view_authoritative=true is worth retesting after pitch-authority and quaternion fixes since it removes the KEX yaw/pitch visual round trip, but stays diagnostic-only until culling/selection/recenter are revalidated. Rejected: promoting it directly to the active baseline.

nodes.label: Decision: Object-Direct Angle Writes Are Yaw-Only
nodes.rationale: SS2VR reads KEX yaw from object+0x58 but reads authoritative pitch from positionData+0x12; writing pitch through FUN_140452a00 updates the object triplet, not the field SS2VR reads back, so direct writes preserve object-triplet pitch and write yaw only. Rejected: pushing HMD pitch into the object triplet, or raw-writing positionData+0x12 without a log-only validation pass first.

nodes.label: Decision: Use Valid Signed-Rotation Quaternion Calibration
nodes.rationale: Individual quaternion component sign-flips are not a valid per-axis calibration when signs differ; replace with a signed rotation-vector rebuild and use the same forward-vector yaw/pitch definition for render residual/logging that game-camera aim uses. Rejected: keeping per-axis sign multipliers, or rebuilding orientation from independent Euler angles (known to cause coupled-axis bugs after large yaw).

nodes.label: Decision: Smooth Turn Uses the KEX Accumulator, Not Object-Direct Yaw
nodes.rationale: The SS2VR-owned direct-yaw accumulator still produced jumpy held turning and pitch-down drift because KEX's canonical camera state can restore/rebase yaw and pitch on later ticks; feed KEX's normal pre-turn mouse accumulator with small analog deltas instead, keeping the pitch servo active during held turn. Rejected: continuing to tune the direct-yaw accumulator/target pitch, or treating direct-write ok=1 as sufficient proof.

nodes.label: Decision: Smooth Turn Must Not Fight UI Ray or HMD Pose History
nodes.rationale: Left/selection beam over the UI overlay made smooth turn go wild, and turning the head with/against the joystick changed turn rate, matching smooth ticks cold-starting HMD yaw history; fix is to stamp the current HMD pose as consumed instead of clearing history, and block smooth-turn queuing briefly after the selection hand hits the UI panel. Rejected: widening the direct-yaw path again, or disabling UI ray globally while turning.

nodes.label: Decision (Superseded): Smooth Turn Owns Its Held-Stick Yaw Target
nodes.rationale: An SS2VR-owned yaw accumulator with pitch mouse-pixel suppression on the same tick, tried after object-direct writes proved callable but still let KEX yaw/pitch jump around it; using current KEX yaw/pitch as rolling baseline preserved the corrupted state being avoided. Superseded by the KEX-accumulator decision.

nodes.label: Principle: Use Original SS2 Mod Data as Semantic Reference Only
nodes.rationale: Mine original SS2/NewDark and NixOS mod material for names, property semantics, message flow, and option concepts, but never treat original/NewDark Squirrel services, DML properties, or cam_ext.cfg commands as callable AE native APIs without Ghidra/runtime confirmation. Track confidence as original-reference -> AE mod-layer confirmed -> AE native binary confirmed; only the last graduates into ADDRESS_REGISTRY.md.

nodes.label: Principle: Keep SEH Native-Call Wrappers POD-Only
nodes.rationale: Any new SEH wrapper for unsafe native calls must be a tiny raw-call helper taking only POD/raw pointer values and returning a simple status; logging, config mutation, std::string, STL containers, and other destructor-bearing objects must stay outside __try/__except, since MSVC rejects __try in functions requiring C++ object unwinding (C2712).

nodes.label: Decision: Stage Native Input Backend, Keep Explicit Fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Add input_backend=native and route only confirmed actions (fire via FUN_140068840, frob via FUN_14048b4f0) through native game-thread calls; movement/jump/crouch/inventory keep keyboard fallback with explicit logs until the real KEX axis dispatcher is found. Rejected: replacing all controls with guessed native calls at once.

nodes.label: Decision: Direct Snap Uses Object-Direct Angles Only
nodes.rationale: Direct snap must use the object-direct angle setter and report success only when angle readback moves by the expected yaw delta, because a prior log loaded direct-yaw mode but actually wrote through the already-falsified generic updater, with readback unchanged and KEX yaw jumping wildly afterward.

nodes.label: Decision: Direct Snap Replaces Same-Tick KEX Yaw
nodes.rationale: Keep direct snap post-PlayerTurnTilt but compute its yaw target from pre-snap KEX yaw, not post-KEX yaw, since if KEX/original yaw moves during the same tick, afterReal-requested can inherit a bad intermediate yaw while before-requested avoids it.

nodes.label: Principle: Promote Useful Hook-Map Data into Compact RE Docs
nodes.rationale: Keep future-hook-map.md as the long historical scratchpad, but route curated evidence/confidence/interpretations into RE_FINDINGS.md and compact RVA/global lookups into ADDRESS_REGISTRY.md, since the scratchpad mixes confirmed addresses, static leads, and falsified experiments and future work needs fast access without re-reading every probe.

nodes.label: Principle: Use Spreadsheet Phase IDs in Project Docs
nodes.rationale: Use PROJECT_PHASES.md and the SS2 VR mod Google Sheet as the canonical task numbering system, adding phase/task IDs to test logs, decisions, hypotheses, and handoffs, because the project has several parallel tracks and numbered IDs make clear which problem a note belongs to.

nodes.label: Decision: Reset Baseline to One Camera Authority
nodes.rationale: Use render_view_authoritative=false, hmd_aim=true, hmd_pitch=true, suppress_render_yaw_pitch=true as the clean baseline, since KEX culling, KEX picking, and the visible HMD view need to agree before controller aim can be judged. Rejected: continuing to stack fixes on split-camera/display-authoritative mode.

nodes.label: Principle: Split INI Parser by Section
nodes.rationale: Parse each ss2vr.ini section in its own small helper instead of extending one large else-if chain, since adding weapon visual keys pushed MSVC into C1061 (blocks nested too deeply); section-local parsers preserve behavior while making future INI options safer to add and audit. Rejected: a generic table/lambda parser (larger, easier to subtly change validation behavior).

nodes.label: Decision: Stage Native Controller Controls Behind Probes
nodes.rationale: Keep the keyboard/mouse bridge available for headset testing while migrating controller actions toward KEX-native command/control paths in stages; fix right-stick jump/crouch sensitivity immediately with separate vertical thresholds rather than reusing the movement deadzone. Rejected: treating analog sticks as only digital keypress generators, or switching every control to unproven native calls at once.

nodes.label: Decision: Test Direct-Yaw Snap Turns
nodes.rationale: Add snap_turn_direct_yaw and set the active test INI true, preserving the mouse-accumulator snap path as immediate revert, since live snap logs with the accumulator path still showed unstable yaw scale/sign and transient KEX pitch spikes; a discrete VR snap should be a yaw-only body/camera step, not a mouse-look impulse.

nodes.label: Decision: Filter Low World Ray-Trace Hits
nodes.rationale: In world_aim_mode=ray_trace, accept direct segment-trace targets only when the hit object id is at least a configurable minimum (default 256); otherwise leave selection to KEX's native candidate picker, since Ghidra shows the native picker scores usable candidates and uses segment trace as LOS, not final selection. Rejected: treating every first collision hit as the frob target, or hard-coding known floor/wall ids.

nodes.label: Decision: Add Angular Pitch Bias for Selection Hand
nodes.rationale: Add aim_pitch_bias_degrees applied to the selection-hand head-local ray before both flat cursor projection and ray_trace, since direct aligned aim missed a wall switch but pitching the controller down ~20 degrees selected it, matching a ~20-degree offset seen elsewhere in camera/picker calibration (an angular frame mismatch, not a target-class problem).

nodes.label: Decision: Prioritize Resolved Weapon Fire Handler Over Launch-Flag Tuning
nodes.rationale: Treat FUN_1403eedd0/0x3EEDD0 as the best current pistol/hitscan aim-takeover candidate after read-only x64dbg enumeration of the live action table resolved a vcall to that RVA; Ghidra shows it performs per-weapon shot setup with two flagged traces, a cleaner aim sink than previously investigated projectile movement/launch callers. Rejected: continuing to tune FUN_14051ee80 launch flags, or globally overriding trace/movement calls without filtering.

nodes.label: Decision: Start Weapon Model Takeover From Object Attachment Evidence
nodes.rationale: For the later visible weapon/hand phase, prioritize CreatureWeaponAttachWeapon, WeaponOffset, PlyrArm, and filtered creature attachment updates before any render-draw or broad transform patch, based on Ghidra evidence for FUN_1403f3090/FUN_1401b6310/FUN_140519380/FUN_1403f25c0 and live-confirmed prologues/property globals. Rejected: editing D3D weapon draws before proving the in-engine object/attachment path.

nodes.label: Principle: Stage Future Weapon Aim/Model Options as Off-by-Default Probes
nodes.rationale: Add disabled-by-default [weapon] gates for the resolved fire handler, WeaponOffset, PlyrArm motion, and creature attachment callback, keeping every new path log-only, since the creature-attachment route may describe NPC/mutant equipment rather than the player viewmodel and should be treated as suspicious until proven.

nodes.label: Decision: Add Pitch-First Late RenderView Residual as Comfort Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Keep the one-camera KEX baseline default, add render_view_late_residual as an opt-in visual-only diagnostic with pitch-only defaults, since full render_view_authoritative=true creates a second camera authority that previously complicated selection/culling. Rejected: returning display-authoritative mode to default, or increasing pitch-servo aggression as the first comfort fix.

nodes.label: Decision: Use KEX Hover Candidates as the Next Left-Hand World-Selection Bridge
nodes.rationale: Add world_candidate_scoring, reusing the existing guarded hover-candidate hook to reassert direct accepted high-object ray hits after KEX native hover scoring, and force the nearest KEX hover candidate near the controller ray, since raw trace is still collision-first for small objects while native screen-space selection is HMD-dependent and flickery. Rejected: more aim_flat_offset_y tuning, flipping the pitch bias negative, or writing a new unguarded object enumeration path.

nodes.label: Decision: Separate Snap-Turn Pixel Gain From HMD Yaw Gain
nodes.rationale: Added snap_turn_pixels_per_degree (0.5) after a requested 20-degree snap injected as 20 yaw pixels produced ~40 degrees of KEX yaw on the next tick, proving HMD yaw-delta gain and controller snap-turn gain are not the same calibration.

nodes.label: Decision: First Comfort Fix Is Pitch-Servo Deadzone, Not Late Residual
nodes.rationale: Lowered pitch_servo_deadzone_degrees from 0.75 to 0.15 and kept render_view_late_residual=false for left-hand selection tests, since the comfort log showed servoPx=0 through slow pitch movement until the old deadzone was crossed, matching perceived stepping.

nodes.label: Principle: Borrow VR Mod Architecture, Not Broad Camera Authority
nodes.rationale: Use other VR mods (JKXR, CSVR, GTFO_VR_Plugin, RoR2VRMod, BendyVR) as architecture references for central pose/ray state and narrow semantic consumers; keep separate UI, world-selection, weapon-aim, and weapon-model paths fed from shared converted pose data. Rejected: returning to a broad display-authoritative camera path, fixing every domain with more flat cursor offsets, or globally patching all segment traces/model transforms.

nodes.label: Decision (Superseded): Park Snap-Turn and Test Smooth Analog Direct Yaw
nodes.rationale: Multiple headset tests still showed snap-turn wrong-direction/jerky/flash-frame prone; switched the active diagnostic to turn_mode=smooth with snap_turn_direct_yaw=true and small joystick-scaled object-direct KEX yaw writes. Superseded by testing smooth analog through KEX's normal pre-turn mouse accumulator instead.

nodes.label: Decision: Make vr.world_scale the Single Metres-to-KEX Conversion
nodes.rationale: Route HMD 6DOF translation, controller-origin world rays, pick-camera probe offsets, world-candidate scoring radii, and stereo physical IPD through a single world_scale, since the previous code had two incompatible unit systems (position_scale for HMD/controller, raw eye_separation for stereo), explaining why leaning, weapon scale, and eye separation could each feel individually tuned but disagree.

nodes.label: Decision: Build the v0.6 DLL-to-Squirrel Weapon Pose Bridge
nodes.rationale: Add model_pose_bridge publishing one raw ss2vr_aim config string for the Squirrel weapon-handoff probe, model-only for the first pass (rotation on, translation off, v0.5 manual offsets as fallback), since v0.5 confirmed the CameraObj control surface and one raw string avoids spamming multiple console set commands per frame. The native bridge calls the guarded FUN_1408d2c20 setter through a POD-only SEH wrapper, failing closed only on an actual call exception.

nodes.label: Decision (Confirmed Live): v0.6 Weapon Rotation
nodes.rationale: Treat the DLL-to-Squirrel pose bridge as validated for visible weapon rotation per user report ('the gun rotates live'); translation, rig-level muzzle/joint pinning, and projectile direction remain separate follow-up tests rather than assumed-solved.

nodes.label: Decision: Build v0.7/v0.8 Squirrel Interaction and Options-Menu Probe
nodes.rationale: Package a probe that keeps the confirmed weapon CameraObj bridge and adds two opt-in spikes: Squirrel-driven ss2vr_sel selection-hand world ray, and a small options.rml override with two SS2VR cvar sliders, testing both contracts without new RVA hooks. Result: loose-file menu/options.rml replacement works, but the .kpf menu override route and arbitrary custom ss2vr_* cvar binding through the vanilla Options data model were both falsified live; the Options-RML probe was removed from the handoff KPF afterward.

nodes.label: Decision: Use Squirrel Scale and Rigid Melee Pose Before Bone IK
nodes.rationale: Add a Squirrel-level ss2vr_weapon_scale control for the viewmodel object's Scale property before retuning stereo/world scale, and prototype rigid controller-driven PlyrArm/wrench reposition first, since Squirrel exposes only bone/joint reads and limited JointPos translation, not general bone rotations. Rejected: retuning world_scale/stereo IPD to hide oversized weapons, or starting with native skeleton memory writes before Squirrel-level rigid pose is tested.

nodes.label: Decision: Build v0.9 Scale, Rigid Melee, and Opt-In Melee Gesture Driver
nodes.rationale: Implement ss2vr_weapon_scale (default 1.0, baseline-safe) in the confirmed Squirrel handler, rigid wrench/arm visual follow as Squirrel-only default-off, and a native melee gesture driver in the DLL as default-off reusing the confirmed native fire action, since the fire bridge is the safest way to test hold/release charge/release before any custom collision path. No bone IK or new RVA hooks added; no native melee-equipped gate yet, so it must remain opt-in.

nodes.label: Decision: Add Default-Off OpenXR Selection Bracket Prototype
nodes.rationale: Add a default-off DLL-side fixed billboard corner bracket in the OpenXR reticle layer rather than jumping to Squirrel-fed PhysDims world boxes or native bracket suppression, since Squirrel can supply gameplay data but cannot draw into the headset 3D scene and the existing selection_marker pipeline already publishes selected-object direction.

nodes.label: Decision: Promote Weapon Basis Mode 1 and Harden Squirrel Interaction Trigger Data
nodes.rationale: Treat ss2vr_weapon_pose_translation_mode=1 as canonical CameraObj basis (forward<-cl.y, left<-cl.x, up<-cl.z) after pose logs identified the basis mismatch directly; extend ss2vr_sel to triggerClick/triggerDown so the one-frame trigger edge isn't lost; keep menu nav flagged not-yet-functional; treat melee empty-space hit sounds as an expected native-aim limitation rather than a chasing target.

nodes.label: Decision: v1.2 Pose/Input Response — Signs, Body-Decoupled Wrench, Secondary Click
nodes.rationale: Turn weapon pose translation on by default and flip default CameraObj lateral/bank signs after testing showed forward/back was useful but left/right and roll were inverted; stop adding Camera.GetFacing() to rigid wrench orientation by default (it caused a figure-eight across body yaw) and derive heading/pitch from the published controller world ray instead; add a right-hand inventory UI route and secondary-button context action.

nodes.label: Decision: v1.3 Correction — Old-Path Left-Interaction Filter
nodes.rationale: Move the immediate noisy-target filter to the older C++ world_candidate_scoring path and add world_candidate_require_native_stage=true (scored candidates forced only when KEX's own post-callback staging/frob globals also name the candidate), since the filter was intended for the older left-hand interaction, not the unproven Squirrel spike, which C++ still lacks native FrobInfo/name/archetype access to classify precisely.

nodes.label: Decision: v1.4 Weapon/Wrench Pose Correction
nodes.rationale: Set CameraObj rotation lock subprops from default-on lock_heading/pitch/bank cvars and replace the default wrench world-absolute orientation with orientation_mode=3 (player-heading-relative, swizzled, pulled back from controller origin), since wrench axes were reported crossed (roll drives pitch, pitch drives roll) and the arm needed to rotate with player heading instead of facing a fixed world direction.

nodes.label: Decision: Add SS2VR-Owned VR Action Panel Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Implement a default-off [vr_action_panel] OpenXR popup using existing Touch A/B actions rather than binding more custom cvars into the vanilla RmlUi Options data model, since arbitrary custom cvar binding was already falsified live; while open, right-trigger fire is suppressed and normal routing is skipped so the test is modal and bounded, and console command strings are parsed/logged but not executed yet.

nodes.label: Decision: v1.5 Restore Player-Relative Weapon Yaw
nodes.rationale: Reverted v1.4's default-on CameraObj rotation locks for the pistol path after user testing falsified the lock-default hypothesis (the pistol stayed facing one world direction regardless of player facing); locks remain available as diagnostics, default 0, so controller pose layers on top of normal player-relative CameraObj composition.

nodes.label: Decision: Start VR-Clean Weapon Mesh Side Quest
nodes.rationale: Stage AE upgraded first-person weapon meshes and hand/arm textures for safe editing, treating clean VR meshes as the preferred fix for forearms/floating geometry visible in room-scale VR, since transform fixes alone cannot reliably hide forearms while preserving hand/weapon/muzzle alignment and the Squirrel CameraObj viewmodel path is already confirmed live.

nodes.label: Decision: v1.6 Implement Squirrel Projectile Aim Stage A
nodes.rationale: Implement the first functional weapon-aim takeover by patching NDShootTriggerScript.OnCreate, gated behind ss2vr_weapon_vr/ss2vr_weapon_aim and default off, prioritizing direction authority over skill/spread polish, since runtime evidence showed pistol/laser paths are projectile-based and prior native trace/launch sinks were either not hit or downstream. ss2vr_aim already publishes right-hand world origin/direction into Squirrel every frame.

nodes.label: Decision: v1.7 Replace Sealed Class Patch With Parallel Projectile Script
nodes.rationale: Directly assigning NDShootTriggerScript.OnCreate failed at runtime with 'trying to set class'; use a parallel SS2VRShootAimScript extends SqRootScript attached via ND.Archetype(...AddScript(...)), the same mechanism base weapon_handler.nut uses, keeping the base script installed and only redirecting player-fired projectiles.

nodes.label: Decision: Use Additive Viewmodels for Left-Hand/Grab Visuals
nodes.rationale: Nightdive's viewmodel system supports multiple simultaneous viewmodels per a developer confirmation; prefer an additive second hand viewmodel for left-hand presence/grab visuals driven through the same CameraObj pose bridge pattern as the right weapon, keeping gameplay interaction/frob ownership separate. This validates the CameraObj workaround as reusable rather than a one-off weapon hack and reduces pressure to solve full skeleton/IK immediately.

nodes.label: Decision: Start VR Tonal Effects as an OpenXR Layer
nodes.rationale: Implement scanline/static/damage/comms visual effects as a head-locked OpenXR composition quad layer submitted after scene projection but before UI/reticle/action-panel/pointer layers, with a manual F5 hotkey cycle for tuning before binding to damage/comms events, since this is much lower risk than a D3D11 post-process or RenderView modification.

nodes.label: Decision: Probe Native Dark Stereo Before Attempting D3D11 Replay
nodes.rationale: Test old Dark toggle_stereo_view/set_stereo_mirror as the next same-frame dual-eye candidate before starting a low-level D3D11 replay implementation, since static RE found a two-pass eye loop with eye-specific RenderView uploads. Result: forcing the byte produced no visual change; the path was parked as inert unless a future D3D11 capture proves the function active.

nodes.label: Decision: Compensate Only the Weapon Viewmodel Pose for HMD 6DOF
nodes.rationale: Keep projectile aim world-space data raw, but compensate the Squirrel CameraObj cl* pose for HMD positional delta, since the OpenXR bridge reports the controller relative to the live HMD while RenderView also applies HMD 6DOF translation, making the model appear to slide when the user moves their head with a stationary controller. Compensating the w* aim fields would corrupt right-hand aim, so only the visual pose is compensated.

nodes.label: Decision: Use Direct LGMD Face-Compaction for First 3ds Max Edited-Mesh Tier
nodes.rationale: Implement the first edited-mesh exporter (Funk Mesh) as a direct LGMD writer instead of continuing through .3ds -> N3ds2e -> BSP, since the BSP path repeatedly produced duplicate points/sliver polygons and modal assertions on AE high-poly viewmodels. Scope narrowly: preserve original vertex table length, allow moved vertices, allow deletion of complete original faces only; reject added faces, vertex deletion, and partial n-gon deletion until a full mesh compiler exists.

nodes.label: Decision (Confirmed Live): Funk Mesh Forearm Trim
nodes.rationale: Treat Funk Mesh v0.4.0-nodefix as the active path for VR-clean weapon mesh surgery limited to moved vertices plus complete-face deletion, after the user confirmed the node-fixed package loads in AE with deleted polygons rendering correctly and all pistol animations preserved. Prior failure modes (header face count, split/call BSP child-node offset remap, modinfo.json requirements) are understood and fixed.

nodes.label: Decision: Suppress Native Offhand Viewmodel Animation Through Squirrel JointPos
nodes.rationale: Do not make the Max exporter responsible for disabling native offhand animation; use the existing late Squirrel weapon handler to force selected JointPos channels after AE's native OnFrameUpdate, since AE weapon animations are Squirrel PointRig keyframes writing JointPos every frame and this can be toggled live without replacing libs/viewmodel.nut. v1.9 defaults (freezing Joint 3, forcing Joint 2) were live-falsified as too aggressive; v1.10 leaves Joint 2 native and only parks Joint 3 at neutral.

nodes.label: Decision: Include an Existing-Save Patcher in Final SS2VR Tooling
nodes.rationale: Add a small offline save patcher so users can add the VR mod package to an existing AE save without starting a new game; default behavior writes a patched copy and leaves the source save untouched, with in-place mode allowed only behind an explicit --in-place flag that creates a timestamped backup first.
